import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Radical
theorem p2_n001 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (p2v3 : Nat) (p2v4 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v4 ≤ p2v2)) (h1 : (p2v2 ≤ p2v0)) (h2 : (p2v1 ≤ p2v4)) (h3 : (p2v3 ≤ p2v1)) : (p2v3 ≤ p2v3) := by
  exact @Lean.Grind.instIsPreorderNat._proof_2 p2v3

theorem p2_n002 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (p2v3 : Nat) (p2v4 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v4 ≤ p2v2)) (h1 : (p2v2 ≤ p2v0)) (h2 : (p2v1 ≤ p2v4)) (h3 : (p2v3 ≤ p2v1)) : (p2v3 ≤ p2v4) := by
  exact @Lean.Grind.instIsPreorderNat._proof_4 p2v3 p2v1 p2v4 h3 h2

theorem p2_n003 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (p2v3 : Nat) (p2v4 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v4 ≤ p2v2)) (h1 : (p2v2 ≤ p2v0)) (h2 : (p2v1 ≤ p2v4)) (h3 : (p2v3 ≤ p2v1)) : (p2v3 ≤ p2v2) := by
  exact @Lean.Grind.instIsPreorderNat._proof_4 p2v3 p2v4 p2v2 (p2_n002 p2v0 p2v1 p2v2 p2v3 p2v4 h0 h1 h2 h3) h0

theorem p2_n004 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (p2v3 : Nat) (p2v4 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v4 ≤ p2v2)) (h1 : (p2v2 ≤ p2v0)) (h2 : (p2v1 ≤ p2v4)) (h3 : (p2v3 ≤ p2v1)) : (p2v3 ≤ p2v0) := by
  exact @Lean.Grind.instIsPreorderNat._proof_4 p2v3 p2v2 p2v0 (p2_n003 p2v0 p2v1 p2v2 p2v3 p2v4 h0 h1 h2 h3) h1
